role: Source authoring proposal for runtime integrator; not a runtime schema or admission
context: Illustrative inland San Diego planted yard with a managed California sycamore and distant high-country view
projection: side-view source composition; physical survey/camera fit unverified
ground_boundary_basis: Manual authored boundary after inspected cedar row's last faint coverage at y493; full visible floor to every canvas edge
placement_policy: Full authored floor is eligible before per-instance footprint/support checks. Optional tree/props do not cut permanent holes in the ground asset. No fixed central placement box.

regional_season_policy.spring: Reuse available greener grass and healthy sycamore canopy
regional_season_policy.summer: Reuse actual existing golden dry grass; sycamore leaf-on only for managed moisture context
regional_season_policy.autumn: Reuse dry seasonal ground plus localized existing sycamore dry leaf/litter art; not universal deciduous canopy
regional_season_policy.winter: Reuse cooler/greener ground; optional bare deciduous tree and conditional distant summit snow after a high-country storm; yard stays snow-free

status_meanings.usable_visual_mask: Raster coverage exists and was inspected; suitable for source compositing experiments
status_meanings.proposed_geometry: Authored image-space placement/contact/depth/elevation estimate requiring runtime-owner review
